mapper.select: SELECT ID AS STOCK_ID ,SYMBOL ,NAME FROM T_STOCK WHERE 1=1 AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND DEL_DAY IS NULL ORDER BY ID
SELECT ID AS STOCK_ID ,SYMBOL ,NAME FROM T_STOCK WHERE 1=1 AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND DEL_DAY IS NULL AND LAST_CLOSE IS NULL ORDER BY ID

SELECT ID AS STOCK_ID ,SYMBOL ,NAME FROM T_STOCK WHERE 1=1 AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND DEL_DAY IS NULL AND (LAST_TRADE_DATE IS NULL OR LAST_TRADE_DATE < #{expected}) ORDER BY (FEATURED_YN = 'Y') DESC ,LAST_CLOSE * SHARES_OUTSTANDING DESC NULLS LAST ,ID

SELECT S.ID AS STOCK_ID ,S.SYMBOL ,S.NAME FROM T_STOCK S LEFT JOIN T_STOCK_PRICE P ON P.STOCK_ID = S.ID WHERE 1=1 AND S.USE_YN = 'Y' AND S.DEL_DAY IS NULL GROUP BY S.ID ,S.SYMBOL ,S.NAME ,S.FEATURED_YN ,S.MARKET ,S.SHARES_OUTSTANDING HAVING COUNT(P.ID) < #{minRows} -- 주요 종목 → 코스피 → 상장 주식 수 많은 순 (큰 종목부터 목록에 빨리 나오게) ORDER BY (S.FEATURED_YN = 'Y') DESC ,(S.MARKET = 'KOSPI') DESC ,S.SHARES_OUTSTANDING DESC NULLS LAST ,S.ID
mapper.update: UPDATE T_STOCK S SET LAST_TRADE_DATE = L.TRADE_DATE ,LAST_CLOSE = L.CLOSE_PRICE ,PREV_CLOSE = L.PREV_CLOSE ,LAST_VOLUME = L.VOLUME FROM ( SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN X.RN = 1 THEN X.TRADE_DATE END) AS TRADE_DATE ,MAX(CASE WHEN X.RN = 1 THEN X.CLOSE_PRICE END) AS CLOSE_PRICE ,MAX(CASE WHEN X.RN = 2 THEN X.CLOSE_PRICE END) AS PREV_CLOSE ,MAX(CASE WHEN X.RN = 1 THEN X.VOLUME END) AS VOLUME FROM ( SELECT P.TRADE_DATE ,P.CLOSE_PRICE ,P.VOLUME ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY P.TRADE_DATE DESC) AS RN FROM T_STOCK_PRICE P WHERE 1=1 AND P.STOCK_ID = #{stockId} ORDER BY P.TRADE_DATE DESC LIMIT 2 ) X ) L WHERE 1=1 AND S.ID = #{stockId} AND L.TRADE_DATE IS NOT NULL
